overview: TaxCore is a multi-tenant ITR workflow and status tracking system for CA firms and tax professionals, with client management, work processing, billing, and role-based access.
features: Firm-wise data isolation with sequential Firm IDs (TaxCore_001, TaxCore_002)
Client Master with PAN-based client type auto-detection
Work Processing with acknowledgment-number-driven filing date and status rules
Dashboard with 6 color-coded tabs and real-time 5-second sync
Excel import and export across all modules
Super Administrator control panel with firm management and recovery tools
Deadline alerts, audit log, and billing
